title: Choose the world for the Iceberg Theory
question: The essay must remain a literal scrollable iceberg. Lock the Filipino visual system around that dive, take the calmer alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Deep Route
options.lineage: hand-painted Philippine jeepney route boards and destination placards
options.thesis: The reader rides a Filipino route downward, with every cultural layer becoming the next stop beneath the waterline.
options.viewport: A confrontational left-hand manifesto, a literal iceberg occupying the center, and a ten-stop jeepney route rail descending at the right; Begin the dive sits above the waterline.
options.risk: The vernacular density must never make the essay feel like a novelty attraction.

raised.raise: Every manifesto claim is immediately proved by a visible iceberg layer.
The depth rail uses uncompromising alignment and a strict level geometry.
All ten depths remain present while the active one strikes forward.
The whole article behaves as one continuous descent rather than disconnected sections.

options.label: The Cultural Dive Log
options.lineage: oceanographic field logs, dive slates, and bathymetric survey charts
options.thesis: A scientific dive log measures what CEFR cannot, recording language as cultural depth rather than a score.
options.viewport: A full-height iceberg cross-section carries the ten levels while a calm field-note column frames Aljohn’s thesis and a depth gauge marks the current layer.
options.risk: It is the most familiar and expected interpretation of an iceberg essay.

options.label: The Cultural Cut
options.lineage: film cutting benches and perforated work-print rails
options.thesis: Each level is one frame in a cultural reel, with the visible tip exposed and the deeper context hanging below the cut.
options.viewport: The headline occupies a black cutting bench while a vertical ten-frame iceberg strip scrubs through Tagalog culture; the stopped layer is marked by a folded tape flag.
options.case: It preserves the sequential dive and speaks to Aljohn’s video world, but the editing metaphor competes with the literal iceberg.
options.risk: The film grammar can overpower the essay’s cultural thesis.

options.label: Fluency, Built in Ten Layers
options.lineage: brick build-instruction books and exploded assembly steps
options.thesis: The iceberg assembles level by level, revealing that technical mastery is only the third piece in a ten-part cultural structure.
options.viewport: An exploded iceberg fills the page as levels one through ten click downward into place beside concise instruction call-outs.
options.case: Its hierarchy is exceptionally clear, but its toy-like optimism does not fully match the manifesto’s confrontational voice.
options.risk: The subject may feel simplified when the deepest layers should feel emotionally heavy.

options.label: Claim / Proof
options.thesis: Every sentence about fluency is paired with the exact iceberg layer that proves it.
options.viewport: A restrained essay column alternates with precise iceberg evidence panels.
options.case: It wins clarity but erases the Filipino cultural world that makes the theory specific.
options.kept: Every claim remains attached to visible evidence.
options.risk: The theory would look interchangeable with any strategy article.

options.label: Point, Line, Depth
options.thesis: Ten cultural layers become a strict compositional study in visible and submerged planes.
options.viewport: A waterline divides a geometric field while ten numbered planes descend below it.
options.case: The structure is clear, but abstraction strips away the media and memory that form Aljohn’s evidence.
options.kept: The level rail inherits its strict alignment and decisive hierarchy.
options.risk: The cultural examples become symbols instead of lived material.

options.label: The Struck Depth
options.lineage: cathode numeral stacks behind bronze anode gauze
options.thesis: All ten levels remain ghosted in the deep while the reader’s current depth strikes forward.
options.viewport: Ten giant ghost numerals recede through water behind a single active orange depth.
options.case: The active-state idea is strong, but the electronic world has no honest connection to Filipino cultural belonging.
options.kept: All ten levels stay visible while one active depth moves forward.
options.risk: It reads as a technical instrument rather than Aljohn’s personal manifesto.

options.label: One Sheet, Ten Folds
options.lineage: a single washi sheet transformed through sequential folds
options.thesis: One language self transforms continuously from vocabulary into cultural instinct.
options.viewport: A single folded iceberg sheet opens downward through ten recoverable states.
options.case: Continuity is valuable, but the Japanese material world conflicts with the Philippine subject.
options.kept: The article becomes one uninterrupted transformation rather than ten cards.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished long-form essay with a sticky table of contents and one static iceberg figure.
canonCard.viewport: A centered headline, author metadata, introduction, and a static iceberg graphic below the fold.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, but it abandons the requested feeling of physically descending through the theory.
